name: Band
description: The styled fallback section: an optional heading, lead, image, a grid of items and buttons, in the section's measured frame and fill. Used where no closer component fits (an unrecognised or low-confidence section), so it still reads as a designed section, never bare text.

layout.description: stack: one column. split: the copy beside the image on wide screens (only with an image).

columns.description: Item columns on wide screens when nothing is measured; one on phones, two on tablets.

align.description: Alignment of the copy and the items.

tone.description: Section background when nothing is measured.

media.label: Image

alt.label: Image description
alt.description: What the image shows, for readers who cannot see it; empty when it is decoration.

media.description: The section's image, under or beside the copy.

items.label: Items

value.label: Figure
value.description: A figure drawn large above the title (a stat with its prefix or suffix, a price).

meta.label: Detail
meta.description: A short line under the title (a role, a date, a period).

text.label: Text
text.description: A sentence or two under the title.

href.label: Link
href.description: Where the item goes; without a link text the whole item is the link.

linkLabel.label: Link text
linkLabel.description: The link's own text, shown under the item.

media.label: Image
media.description: Image on top of the item.

mediaAlt.label: Image description
mediaAlt.description: What the image shows, for readers who cannot see it; empty when it is decoration.

icon.label: Icon
icon.description: A small image above the title (decoration).

points.label: Points
points.description: A short list under the text (features, facts).

items.description: Items in a grid (cards, features, logos), in order.

href.label: Link
href.description: Where the button goes: a page on this site or a full address.

newTab.label: Open in a new tab
newTab.description: Open the link in a new tab (an external site the reader should not leave for).

style.label: Style
style.description: primary for the main action, secondary or ghost for the ones beside it.

headingLevel.description: Level of the section heading; item titles are one below, or at this level when there is no heading.

measured.description: The source section's measured style (MeasuredStyle): frame width, padding, fill, image, columns per width, gap, text tone, radius, minimum height — all in pixels. Absent, the site's tokens; present, it wins over tone and columns. Values that are not a number, a colour or a known keyword are dropped.

color.description: Fill colour: hex, rgb(a) or hsl(a).

image.description: Background image address (http(s) or root-relative), drawn behind the content.

overlay.description: Colour laid over the image, with its alpha.

size.description: How the image fills the section.

position.description: One or two of center/top/bottom/left/right or percentages.

columns.description: Item columns at 390 (base), 768 (md) and 1280 (lg) px; a missing width follows the narrower one.

tone.description: What the text is set for: dark = light text on a dark band. Without it, a fill's own lightness decides.

id.description: Anchor id of the section; the heading gets `<id>-title`.

a11y: A labelled region (aria-labelledby its heading) when it has one. Item titles sit one level under the heading. An item with a link and no link text is clickable as a whole through its title's link; icons are decoration (alt="").
